result.summary: Analyzed the page for visual defects; found one major layout issue.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated on the right edge of the screen, with its full name and content cut off in a way that disrupts the consistent card layout of the row.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel layout to ensure that even partially visible cards are properly contained and their key content (like full name) is either fully readable when scrolled to or the card is designed to gracefully handle partial visibility with ellipses or adjusted sizing.
